acceptance_criteria: AC196-1: Settings has its own Engine Profiles tab with create/read/edit/delete/active selection through scoped durable SurrealDB authority; definitions and active choice survive restart.
AC196-2: Chatbox model choice selects a full immutable profile; same-model/different-engine/device/settings profiles remain distinct through serialization/backend dispatch.
AC196-3: Complete identity/revision/model artifact digest/engine/preset/device/fingerprint remain in selection audit and genuine run/lane/session records; recovery uses the pinned snapshot.

AC196-4: Scoped backend validation precedes effects. Unknown/deleted/stale profile, digest/capability/policy mismatch, cross-account/workspace and unavailable-device failures are typed/non-mutating; no silent fallback.

AC196-5: Prelaunch audit has legitimate coordinator ownership and genuine required scope/run binding. Never fabricate run_id, weaken scope or accept after audit failure. Edit/delete/inventory and late acknowledgements preserve revision correlation and started runs.

AC196-6: Genuine Qwen3-0.6B GenieX QAIRT NPU and Qwen3-4B-abliterated Q4_0 GenieX llama_cpp CPU execute with selected-profile lineage and actual result/device/cleanup evidence. Historical4B NPU proof is not CPU proof.

AC196-7: Same-change manual and stable native model-navigable controls drive the actual workflow; component/storage/source/compile evidence remains distinct from production runtime and independent WP acceptance.
